newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein easier in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein easier in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were lower in late trading on Tuesday on a lack of buying interest amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,470-75 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,475-80 rupiah at the opening, but offers were also heard at five rupiah below and above the range.
The traders said crude palm oil was on offer at 1,300 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan, but buyers were eyeing 1,290 rupiah.
"Buying interest was moderate to slow, following continued falls in Malaysia," one trader said.
"Buyers see the possibility of local prices coming down as well tomorrow," he said.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Sonla will leave the North Sumatran port for Rotterdam on Thursday with 13,570 tonnes of crude palm oil.
The MT Pertola will leave on Wednesday for Kuala Enok on Batam Island with 1,300 tonnes of palm olein.
